notes:
Thumps is a siamese twin with gigantism. Like Pierre, there are just a lot of this guy, and the narrative does not explain why - don't worry about it.

He's essentially the ogre of the  peasantry - not quite as fearsome as an ogre, but with passives which play off his dual heads/personality. He can't be as easily ganged up on because he can look both ways, simultaneously.
